naming.press_a: type the highlighted glyph, or confirm END

battle.press_a: confirm the highlighted battle command or move
battle.press_b: back out of a battle submenu
battle.skip_dialog: advance narrative text; B-only, does not press A

dialog.skip_dialog: advance narrative text; B-only, does not press A
dialog.press_b: cancel or back out; does not start a conversation

title.press_a: confirm NEW GAME or a menu item
title.press_b: cancel or back out; does not start a conversation
title.skip_dialog: advance narrative text; B-only, does not press A

overworld.press_a: confirm, talk, or interact with the tile in front
overworld.press_b: cancel or back out; does not start a conversation
